text: Cooking is a delightful art that can elevate simple ingredients into a culinary masterpiece. Garlic, a versatile and aromatic spice, is often the first addition to many dishes, adding a bold and savory flavor. Onions, a fundamental ingredient, are then introduced to balance the garlic's intensity, creating a harmonious flavor profile that enhances the overall taste of the dish. Whether sautéed, roasted, or simply minced, both garlic and onions play crucial roles in a wide range of cuisines, from Italian pasta to Asian stir-fries, bringing depth and warmth to every meal.
